title: conjugation
description: The full inflection table for one verb or adjective. It is addressed by the vocab entry it belongs to, so `slug` here is a foreign key into vocab, not a new address.

x-yomineko.vocabulary_policy: Types, nesting and `required` are measured from the data. Value sets are not: every `enum` here is either declared in a design document, parsed from the code that produces the value, or curated in build_schemas.py with its source named in x-vocabulary. See contracts/README.md.

class.description: Inflection class this table was generated from. Vocabulary owner: producer — scripts/ingest/conjugate.py (verb_class ∪ adj_class — the conjugation bank keys on both). Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

x-vocabulary.source: scripts/ingest/conjugate.py (verb_class ∪ adj_class — the conjugation bank keys on both)

form.description: Which inflected form this is. Vocabulary owner: producer — scripts/ingest/conjugate.py VERB_FORMS + ADJ_FORMS. Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.

kind.description: Whether this is a verb or an adjective paradigm. Vocabulary owner: producer — scripts/ingest/conjugate.py (VERB_FORMS vs ADJ_FORMS). Widening it is an edit there, never a side effect of regenerating this schema from the data.
